WITH gw AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (host_name) host_name,
    COALESCE(technology, 'Unknown') as gw_technology,
    COALESCE(network_type, 'Unknown') as gw_network_type,
    COALESCE(modem_name, 'Unknown') as gw_model,
    COALESCE(firmware_version, 'Unknown') as gw_firmware,
    COALESCE(hgw_mac, 'Unknown') as gw_mac
  FROM gw_info_latest
  ORDER BY host_name, started_at DESC
),
ident AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (name) regexp_replace(script_ref, '^.*/', '') as name, prefix, display_name
  FROM executable_identity WHERE kind = 'script'
  ORDER BY name, updated_at DESC
),
enriched_results AS (
  SELECT
    sr.*,
    COALESCE(gw.gw_technology, 'Unknown') as gw_technology,
    COALESCE(gw.gw_network_type, 'Unknown') as gw_network_type,
    COALESCE(gw.gw_model, 'Unknown') as gw_model,
    COALESCE(gw.gw_firmware, 'Unknown') as gw_firmware,
    COALESCE(gw.gw_mac, 'Unknown') as gw_mac
  FROM script_results sr
  LEFT JOIN gw ON gw.host_name = sr.host_name
  WHERE sr.script_name IN ('ookla_speedtest', 'superping', 'dns_lookuptime', 'facebook_check', 'youtube_video_check')
    AND $__timeFilter(sr.started_at)
)
SELECT
  COALESCE('[' || i.prefix || '] ' || i.display_name, i.display_name, er.script_name) as "Test Category",
  COUNT(*) as "Total Tests",
  COUNT(CASE WHEN er.success THEN 1 END) as "Passed",
  COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT er.success THEN 1 END) as "Failed",
  ROUND((COUNT(CASE WHEN er.success THEN 1 END)::decimal / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100, 1) as "Success Rate %"
FROM enriched_results er
LEFT JOIN ident i ON i.name = er.script_name
WHERE 1=1 AND success::text = ANY(string_to_array('${success:csv}', ','))
  AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND ('${host:csv}' = '' OR host_name = ANY(string_to_array('${host:csv}', ',')))
  AND ('${device_name:csv}' = '' OR device_name = ANY(string_to_array('${device_name:csv}', ',')))
  AND ('${technology:csv}' = '' OR gw_technology = ANY(string_to_array('${technology:csv}', ',')) OR gw_technology = 'Unknown')
  AND ('${network:csv}' = '' OR gw_network_type = ANY(string_to_array('${network:csv}', ',')) OR gw_network_type = 'Unknown')
  AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR gw_model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')) OR gw_model = 'Unknown')
  AND ('${firmware:csv}' = '' OR gw_firmware = ANY(string_to_array('${firmware:csv}', ',')) OR gw_firmware = 'Unknown')
  AND ('${mac:csv}' = '' OR gw_mac = ANY(string_to_array('${mac:csv}', ',')) OR gw_mac = 'Unknown')
GROUP BY er.script_name, i.prefix, i.display_name
ORDER BY 1
